60536-the-girl-s-own-paper-vol-xx-no-101.creator: Unknown
60536-the-girl-s-own-paper-vol-xx-no-101.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “Well, m’m,” she said, “I beg your pardon for anything that’s happened. I’ve often wondered what you thought o’ me speaking so much o’ the master, an’ me never set eyes on him. But ’twas because I was a-thinkin’ o’ you, an’ a-prayin’ you may never know what it is to be a widow-woman.

69991-stock-and-stalks.title: _A Book for the Dairy Farmer_
69991-stock-and-stalks.creator: J. R. Roberts
69991-stock-and-stalks.description: A book by J. R. Roberts. Some blame our agricultural colleges for not knowing more and knowing it sooner, and for spreading what we now know to have been in some cases misinformation. But the course taken was really the only one possible. Experiment stations have to try out a lot of theories in order to find which are wrong and which are right.

70666-the-ethics-of-hercules.title: Determinant of Ethical Values_
70666-the-ethics-of-hercules.creator: Robert Chenault Givler, Ph.D.
70666-the-ethics-of-hercules.description: A book by Robert Chenault Givler, Ph.D.. This modern question, upon which the founding of a true science of ethics depends, cannot be answered by any appeal to the speculative metaphysics of bygone generations. We have passed out of that period in which men were content with an explanation based on the Zoroastrian hypothesis of a world divided between the warring forces of light and darkness, while our ears are now equally unresponsive to the bi-polar principles of love and hate which Empedocles propounded.

arxiv-2105-00499.title: Curious Exploration and Return-based Memory Restoration for Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2105-00499.creator: Saeed Tafazzol, Erfan Fathi, Mahdi Rezaei, Ehsan Asali
arxiv-2105-00499.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Saeed Tafazzol, Erfan Fathi, Mahdi Rezaei, Ehsan Asali. Reward engineering and designing an incentive reward function are non-trivial tasks to train agents in complex environments. Furthermore, an inaccurate reward function may lead to a biased behaviour which is far from an efficient and optimised behaviour. In this paper, we focus on training a single agent to score goals with binary success/failure reward function in Half Field Offense domain.

arxiv-2110-13501.title: Tensor Network Kalman Filtering for Large-Scale LS-SVMs
arxiv-2110-13501.creator: Maximilian Lucassen, Johan A.K. Suykens, Kim Batselier
arxiv-2110-13501.description: Abstract Least squares support vector machines are a commonly used supervised learning method for nonlinear regression and classification. They can be implemented in either their primal or dual form. The latter requires solving a linear system, which can be advantageous as an explicit mapping of the data to a possibly infinite-dimensional feature space is avoided.

arxiv-2111-07350.title: A modular equality for m m –ovoids of elliptic quadrics
arxiv-2111-07350.creator: Alexander L. Gavrilyuk and Klaus Metsch and Francesco Pavese
arxiv-2111-07350.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexander L. Gavrilyuk and Klaus Metsch and Francesco Pavese. An m m -ovoid of a finite polar space 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is a set 𝒪 \mathcal{O} of points such that every maximal subspace of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} contains exactly m m points of 𝒪 \mathcal{O} .

arxiv-2201-04913.title: Compressing Word Embeddings Using Syllables
arxiv-2201-04913.creator: Laurent Mertens, Joost Vennekens
arxiv-2201-04913.description: Abstract This work examines the possibility of using syllable embeddings, instead of the often used n n -gram embeddings, as subword embeddings. We investigate this for two languages: English and Dutch. To this end, we also translated two standard English word embedding evaluation datasets, WordSim353 and SemEval-2017, to Dutch.

arxiv-2203-03279.title: Evaluating State of the Art, Forecasting Ensembles- and Meta-learning Strategies for Model Fusion
arxiv-2203-03279.creator: Pieter Cawood, Terence van Zyl
arxiv-2203-03279.description: Abstract Techniques of hybridisation and ensemble learning are popular model fusion techniques for improving the predictive power of forecasting methods. With limited research that instigates combining these two promising approaches, this paper focuses on the utility of the Exponential Smoothing - Recurrent Neural Network (ES-RNN) in the pool of base learners for different ensembles.

arxiv-2211-14201.title: A divide and conquer sequential Monte Carlo approach to high dimensional filtering
arxiv-2211-14201.creator: Francesca R. Crucinio, Adam M. Johansen
arxiv-2211-14201.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Francesca R. Crucinio, Adam M. Johansen. We propose a divide-and-conquer approach to filtering which decomposes the state variable into low-dimensional components to which standard particle filtering tools can be successfully applied and recursively merges them to recover the full filtering distribution. It is less dependent upon factorization of transition densities and observation likelihoods than competing approaches and can be applied to a broader class of models.

arxiv-2309-07706.title: Enhanced Non-linear Response by Manipulating the Dirac Point in the (111) LaTiO 3 /SrTiO 3 Interface
arxiv-2309-07706.creator: G. Tuvia, A. Burshtein, I. Silber, A. Aharony, O. Entin-Wohlman, M. Goldstein, Y. Dagan
arxiv-2309-07706.description: Abstract Tunable spin-orbit interaction (SOI) is an important feature for future spin-based devices. In the presence of a magnetic field, SOI induces an asymmetry in the energy bands, which can produce non-linear transport effects ( V ∼ I 2 V\sim I^{2} ).

arxiv-2410-23819.title: Weight decay induces low-rank attention layers
arxiv-2410-23819.creator: Seijin Kobayashi, Yassir Akram *, Johannes von Oswald
arxiv-2410-23819.description: Abstract The effect of regularizers such as weight decay when training deep neural networks is not well understood. We study the influence of weight decay as well as L ​ 2 L2 -regularization when training neural network models in which parameter matrices interact multiplicatively.

arxiv-2504-10378.title: Cosmogenic Neutrino Point Source and KM3-230213A
arxiv-2504-10378.creator: Qinyuan Zhang (张秦源), Tian-Qi Huang (黄天奇), Zhuo Li (黎卓)
arxiv-2504-10378.description: Abstract Cosmogenic neutrinos (CNs) are produced by ultra-high energy cosmic rays (UHECRs) interacting with cosmic background radiation. We investigated the properties of CN point/extended sources, i.e, the neutrino spectrum, and angular profile as functions of time, by assuming that UHECR sources are transient events, such as gamma-ray bursts.

arxiv-2511-05626.title: LLMs as Packagers of HPC Software
arxiv-2511-05626.creator: Caetano Melone, Daniel Nichols, Konstantinos Parasyris, Todd Gamblin, Harshitha Menon Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory Email: cmelone@llnl.gov , harshitha@llnl.gov
arxiv-2511-05626.description: Abstract . High performance computing (HPC) software ecosystems are inherently heterogeneous, comprising scientific applications that depend on hundreds of external packages, each with distinct build systems, options, and dependency constraints. Tools such as Spack automate dependency resolution and environment management, but their effectiveness relies on manually written build recipes.

arxiv-2601-19270.title: Confinement and Chiral Phase Transitions: The Role of Polyakov Loop Kinetics Terms
arxiv-2601-19270.creator: Banghui Hua, Jiang Zhu
arxiv-2601-19270.description: Abstract We studied a crucial but often oversimplified ingredient in predicting gravitational-wave signals from QCD-type phase transitions: the kinetic term of the Polyakov loop. For the first time, we derive this term from first principles in finite-temperature pure SU(3) Yang-Mills theory, incorporating a field-dependent renormalization factor—a calculation we also extend to theories with more colors.

pmc-10574738.title: Exogenous Ketone Supplementation and Ketogenic Diets for Exercise: Considering the Effect on Skeletal Muscle Metabolism
pmc-10574738.creator: Hannah Khouri, John R Ussher, Céline Aguer, Antoni Sureda
pmc-10574738.description: In recent years, ketogenic diets and ketone supplements have increased in popularity, particularly as a mechanism to improve exercise performance by modifying energetics. Since the skeletal muscle is a major metabolic and locomotory organ, it is important to take it into consideration when considering the effect of a dietary intervention, and the impact of physical activity on the body.

pmc-10599366.title: Failure of a Reverse Total Shoulder Arthroplasty with a Broken Humeral Stem Tray: A Case Report
pmc-10599366.creator: Mehmet Kaymakoglu, Furkan Aral, Gazi Huri
pmc-10599366.description: Introduction:The evolution of prosthesis design has increased the frequency of RTSA procedures across various indications. This rise in surgeries has also led to a growing number of associated complications. This case report highlights an unusual occurrence: a mechanical failure of a RTSA at the humeral stem tray.

pmc-11474552.title: The Impact of a Twice-daily Versus Once-daily Proton Pump Inhibitor Dosing Regimen on Laryngopharyngeal Reflux Symptoms: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11474552.creator: Jeong-Yeon Ji, Gene Huh, Eunjeong Ji, Jin Yi Lee, Seung Heon Kang, Wonjae Cha, Woo-Jin Jeong, Young Ho Jung
pmc-11474552.description: Background/AimsProton pump inhibitors (PPIs) play a crucial role in managing laryngopharyngeal reflux (LPR), but the optimal dosing regimen remains unclear. We aim to compare the effectiveness of the same total PPI dose administered twice daily versus once daily in LPR patients.

pmc-11676332.title: Radiofrequency Ablation for Unstable Ruptured Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-11676332.creator: Matteo Pagani, Carla Tasca, Rosita De Vincenti, Massimo Fedi
pmc-11676332.description: Spontaneous liver bleeding is a rare but life-threatening complication of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The optimal management strategy for this condition remains a topic of ongoing debate. We present the case of a 74-year-old man with cirrhosis and hemorrhagic shock resulting from the spontaneous rupture of HCC. Following a contrast-enhanced CT scan, the patient underwent emergency laparotomy.

pmc-12643296.title: Assessing agricultural effects on benthic invertebrate communities in ponds and ditches using δ¹⁵N and δ¹³C isotope niches
pmc-12643296.creator: Fee Nanett Trau, Kathrin Fisch, Stefan Lorenz, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica, Marina Vilenica
pmc-12643296.description: Agriculture is one of the dominant types of land use worldwide. The land conversion and intensification of agriculture have severe impacts on biodiversity and the associated ecosystem functions in the production areas and in natural or semi-natural habitats embedded in the agricultural landscape.

pmc-12666428.title: Tailored management of chronic bacterial prostatitis with sequential fluoroquinolones and adverse effect mitigation strategies: A case report
pmc-12666428.creator: Thao D Nguyen
pmc-12666428.description: Chronic bacterial prostatitis (CBP) presents diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, particularly in patients with drug allergies and atypical symptom profiles. This case describes a retired male healthcare professional with exclusive penile pain and urinary symptoms, diagnosed with CBP. Management involved sequential fluoroquinolone therapy—ciprofloxacin followed by moxifloxacin—over 6.5 weeks, guided by clinical condition and pharmacokinetic/ pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) considerations.

pmc-13074064.title: Cytotoxic Drug Handling Practices Among Pharmacy Technicians in Portugal: The Dig Deeper Study
pmc-13074064.creator: Ana Reis, Vítor Silva, João José Joaquim, Cristiano Matos, Carolina Valeiro, Cristiana Freitas, Olívia R. Pereira, Ramona Mateos-Campos, Fernando Moreira
pmc-13074064.description: Background: Occupational exposure to cytotoxic drugs remains a major concern for pharmacy personnel, due to their well-established, carcinogenic, mutagenic and organ-specific effects. Despite the existence of robust international guidelines, evidence suggests substantial variability in compliance, training quality and operational conditions across healthcare settings.

pmc-13559471.title: Digital Fabrication of Complete Dentures Using Multifunctional Custom Trays: A Case Report
pmc-13559471.creator: Zhenyan Liao, Ruyi Li, Jing Luo, Jian Liao, Qianbing Wan, Jian Wang, Zihan He
pmc-13559471.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Conventional complete denture fabrication is a complex, multi‐step clinical procedure. This clinical report presents a novel digital modality utilizing multifunctional custom trays based on a virtual patient. These trays consolidate key clinical steps—including definitive impressions, esthetic preview of the maxillary teeth, and jaw relation records—into a single appointment, thereby reducing procedural complexity and minimizing the repeated insertions and removals of different appliances throughout the treatment course.
